title: The Story That Changes With Every Telling
title_ja: 語られるたびに変わる物語

source_links.title: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: Oral Traditions and Expressions

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: At a village festival, an elderly storyteller begins a tale that many people already know.
sentences.ja: 村の祭りで高齢の語り手が多くの人の知る物語を語り始めます。

sentences.en: Children listen as the storyteller describes a journey through a mysterious forest.
sentences.ja: 子どもたちは語り手が不思議な森の旅を描くのを聞きます。

sentences.en: However, the story sounds a little different from the version they heard last year.
sentences.ja: しかしその話は昨年聞いた版と少し違って聞こえます。

sentences.en: A new character appears, and one part of the journey is shorter.
sentences.ja: 新しい登場人物が現れ、旅の一部は短くなっています。

sentences.en: The changes do not necessarily mean that the storyteller has forgotten the story.
sentences.ja: 変化は語り手が物語を忘れたことを必ずしも意味しません。

sentences.en: Oral traditions often involve both remembering and creating during a performance.
sentences.ja: 口承の伝統には、演じる中で思い出すことと創り出すことの両方が含まれます。

sentences.en: UNESCO describes oral traditions as a way to pass on knowledge and cultural values.
sentences.ja: ユネスコは口承の伝統を知識や文化的な価値を伝える方法と説明します。

sentences.en: For example, stories may teach listeners how a community understands kindness or courage.
sentences.ja: 例えば物語は地域が親切や勇気をどう理解するか伝える場合があります。

sentences.en: Different storytellers may emphasize different details for their audiences.
sentences.ja: 語り手によって聞き手に向けて強調する細部は異なるかもしれません。

sentences.en: A story told to very young children may use simpler words and more repeated phrases.
sentences.ja: 幼い子ども向けの物語は簡単な語や繰り返しの表現を増やすかもしれません。

sentences.en: Another performance may include a song or a question that invites the audience to answer.
sentences.ja: 別の上演では歌や聞き手への質問が含まれるかもしれません。

sentences.en: The living tradition is more than one fixed written text.
sentences.ja: 生きた伝統は固定された一つの文章以上のものです。

sentences.en: Recording a storyteller can help preserve a performance for the future.
sentences.ja: 語り手を録音することは上演を未来へ残す助けになります。

sentences.en: In addition, a video may capture gestures and the reactions of listeners.
sentences.ja: さらに動画は身振りや聞き手の反応も記録できます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, one recording cannot represent every possible version of the story.
sentences.ja: それでも一つの記録で物語のあらゆる版を代表できるわけではありません。

sentences.en: The tradition may depend on people continuing to tell stories in homes and schools.
sentences.ja: その伝統は家庭や学校で語り続ける人々に依存するかもしれません。

sentences.en: A recording should support living storytellers rather than replace them.
sentences.ja: 記録は生きた語り手に取って代わるのではなく支えるべきです。

sentences.en: The people who keep a tradition alive should have a voice in how it is shared.
sentences.ja: 伝統を生かし続ける人々は、その共有方法に意見を言えるべきです。

sentences.en: A class can explore the idea by telling the same short story in small groups.
sentences.ja: クラスは小グループで同じ短い物語を語り、この考えを調べられます。

sentences.en: Students can compare how the details change while the main message remains recognizable.
sentences.ja: 生徒は主なメッセージがわかるまま細部がどう変わるか比較できます。

sentences.en: They should not assume that one version is automatically the only correct one.
sentences.ja: 一つの版が自動的に唯一の正解だと思うべきではありません。

sentences.en: Instead, they can ask which elements are important to the people who tell and hear the story.
sentences.ja: 代わりに語る人と聞く人にとって重要な要素を尋ねられます。

sentences.en: Keeping a tradition alive means leaving room for both memory and creativity.
sentences.ja: 伝統を生かし続けることは記憶と創造性の両方に余地を残すことです。

options: Oral traditions can remain alive through both preservation and creative retelling.
Only children can tell traditional stories.
questions.explanation_ja: 口承伝統の保存と創造的継承が主題です。

questions.prompt: How is the festival story different this year?
options: It is written on a wall.
questions.explanation_ja: 新しい登場人物が出てきます。

questions.prompt: Why doesn't a changed story necessarily show poor memory?
options: Oral performance can involve creativity as well as remembering.
questions.explanation_ja: 語りには創造的な変更も含まれるからです。

questions.prompt: What can oral traditions pass on?
questions.explanation_ja: 知識や文化的価値を伝えます。

questions.prompt: How might a story change for younger listeners?
options: It may use simpler words and repeated phrases.
It can never include a song.
questions.explanation_ja: 簡単な語や繰り返しの表現が使われます。

questions.prompt: Why is recording one performance insufficient?
options: The story may have several living versions.
questions.explanation_ja: 伝統の多様な版を一つで表せないからです。

options: Record or show something in detail.
questions.explanation_ja: captureは記録する・捉えるという意味です。

questions.prompt: Where might people keep telling stories?
questions.explanation_ja: 家庭や学校が挙げられています。

questions.prompt: Why should storytellers have a say in sharing traditions?
options: They always own every recording device.
Their knowledge and participation help keep traditions alive.
questions.explanation_ja: 継承者の参加が伝統の維持に重要だからです。

questions.prompt: Why does the writer suggest a classroom storytelling task?
options: To prove change is always wrong.
To experience how retelling can preserve meaning while varying details.
questions.explanation_ja: 変化する細部と残る意味を体験するためです。
